BrochureContent.Content:
James Murphy Kinsale Property is delighted to present 8 Oysterhaven Holiday Cottages, a charming 3-bedroom semi-detached property. This residence enjoys a picturesque location overlooking Oysterhaven Bay, set within a peaceful environment rich in scenic walking trails. It is conveniently situated just 9 kilometers from the vibrant town of Kinsale, which offers a diverse selection of shops and amenities, while Cork Airport is a mere 22 kilometers away. Oysterhaven Holiday Cottages is part of a select development with a mix of holiday homes and all year round family homes located just a stone’s throw from the stunning Oysterhaven Bay, beautiful beaches, and an abundance of water sports activities.

The well-designed layout of the cottage features a spacious open-plan living area, complete with a large stove fireplace. The fully equipped kitchen flows seamlessly into the dining area, creating an ideal space for family gatherings and entertaining. The cottage includes three bright double bedrooms, complemented by a generous bathroom on the ground floor, as well as an additional bathroom on the first floor. The living area, kitchen, bathrooms, and hallway are fully tiled, while the bedrooms are adorned with elegant wooden flooring.

Exterior highlights include a lovely garden and patio area at the front, along with two designated parking spaces. An individual storage enclosure in the car park, measuring approximately 4.5 meters long by 2 meters wide, features a timber shed of 2.4 meters long by 1.9 meters wide and 2 meters tall.  In 2026, four new Velux windows were installed on the property. The remaining windows and doors are timber/Aluclad triple-glazed units, which were installed in 2022. Additionally, the stove and all appliances are brand new.

The annual management fees are €2,200, which encompass:
- House insurance
- Potable (safe and clean) water supply and treatment.
- Wastewater treatment.
- External lighting.
- Site maintenance.

This property represents an excellent opportunity as a family holiday home or investment property. The Oysterhaven Activity Centre, located within walking distance, offers a myriad of water sports activities right at your doorstep.

Location
Kinsale is one of Ireland's most picturesque, popular and fashionable towns, which is situated only 17 miles from Cork city, making this an ideal location for those wishing to commute to the city. The pretty seaside town is a mere 25-minute drive from the cosmopolitan city of Cork. This area of Southwest Ireland is of outstanding beauty with its dramatic coastline, unspoilt locations and safe beaches. Leisure activities are well catered for, Kinsale provides excellent sailing, yachting and fishing facilities from its two marinas. There are three world-class golf courses, including the renowned Old Head of Kinsale. Other recreational pursuits include walking, bathing, surfing, and horse riding.
There are numerous cultural events held throughout the year, such as the world-famous Kinsale Arts Festival, the Cork Jazz Festival, the Cork Film Festival, and the Kinsale Gourmet Festival, along with a thriving music and opera programme. Cork has several fine theatres, and Cork Opera House hosts many exceptional productions throughout the year. Kinsale is also home to some of Ireland's finest restaurants, contributing to its title as the Gourmet Capital of Ireland, along with many top-class hotels and lots of welcoming pubs. Cork International Airport is conveniently located 20 minutes and drive from Kinsale with direct links within Ireland and to Major European and UK cities
